basic_info.description:
The Neighborhood:
This "secret neighborhood" in the southeastern part of the city offers the perfect blend of tucked-away tranquility and vibrant community feel. Bordered by McClaren Park with its children's playground, bike park, and hiking trails, residents enjoy abundant recreational opportunities right at their doorstep.

The area features diverse dining options within walking distance and provides a commuter's dream location with easy access to both 101 & 280 freewaysideal whether you work in SF or the South Bay.

The Unit:
This architecturally stunning 2-bedroom unit (2-bedroom with office) condo features a spacious, light-filled open layout with new hardwood floors throughout. The upgraded kitchen boasts stainless steel appliances, gas range, washer/dryer, dishwasher, and ample cabinet and counter space that flows seamlessly into the dining and living areas.

Key Features:
 Master bedroom with ensuite bath (shower over tub) and dual closets
 Second bedroom with step-out balcony and generous closet space
 Additional hall bath with beautiful stone finishes
 Gas Fireplace
 Double-pane windows throughout
 One-car garage space

Terms:
 Utilities Included: Garbage
 Laundry In Unit
 Parking
 No Pets

 Enjoy the benefits of the Resident Benefits Package (RBP), tailored to your needs. Choose from our tiered pricing options, starting at just $25.99*/month.

Your RBP may include:
-Liability insurance
-HVAC air filter delivery (for applicable properties)
-On-demand pest control
-And more!
Contact us today to learn more about the RBP tiers and find the perfect fit for you.
